Festivals · April · Oti

Hyirebo

The festival of peace

Hyirebo, also called the Boriwiman festival, is the state festival of Bowiri Amanforo in the Biakoye District of the Oti Region. It celebrates peace and the sanctification of the state, and closes the traditional year. It is held in the first week of April.

When
The first week of April
Where
Bowiri Amanforo, Biakoye District, Oti Region
Kept by
The chiefs and people of Bowiri Amanforo
Also called
Boriwiman festival
Region
Oti

Why Hyirebo

The ancestors left an existing Mmowere state to found a new one, and named the land Mmowere Amanforo, “the new state of Mmowere”. They set up Hyirebo to proclaim it, and it has been kept ever since, for peace, unity and the progress of the state.1

The week

  1. Sunday

    Homecoming

    People who live away come home.1

  2. Monday

    Work together

    Meetings and communal labour in every town.1

  3. Tuesday

    Great taboo day

    No heavy farm work; only family and clan meetings.1

  4. Wednesday

    Wailing

    Morning rites in every clan and wailing for fallen heroes and loved ones.1

  5. Thursday

    Feasting

    Families feast, and animals are slaughtered.1

  6. Friday

    White clay and the durbar

    At dawn families bathe in the river, women and children first, then smear white clay on their bodies. Clan and town processions come to the durbar ground with drums and festival songs, for speeches, an appeal for development funds and dancing until evening.1

  7. Sunday

    Thanksgiving

    An interdenominational thanksgiving service.1

Good to know if you go

  • Where: Bowiri is in the Biakoye District. See the Oti page for places nearby.
  • Also in Bowiri: Fussikur, the migration festival, between February and March.
  • Check the dates: the traditional council sets them each year. Local radio and the national press carry the announcement.
  • Respect the rites: some rituals are sacred and not for cameras. Ask before photographing chiefs, priests or anyone taking part, and follow what the ushers ask.

Questions people ask

What is the Hyirebo festival?

The festival of peace of Bowiri Amanforo in the Oti Region, which closes the traditional year.

When is Hyirebo?

In the first week of April.

Sources

  1. “Oti Region: the tradition and cultural heritage of Oti Region”, National Commission on Culture.
